performance.verdict: Nine overdue milestones mean ads are spending blind — fix infra before buying more.

findings.text: 5 of 9 SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 are undelivered: stack test, CRM migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages — all 46+ days overdue.
4 further SOW milestones due Aug 31–Sep 1 also undelivered: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA submission, and nurture sequences.
Lead drought confirmed: $159.10 spent on Meta over 28 days, 308 clicks, 0 tracked leads and 0 GA4 conversions — conversion tracking or landing page capture is broken.
Spend rose +66.81% in the last 7 days (top campaign MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP at $67.39) while GBP actions fell -57.14% — budget scaling into awareness with no bottom-funnel in place.
GBP 3-day signal: 0 actions on Sep 12–13 vs avg ~3/day in prior 3 days (Sep 9–11 avg 2.0) — organic local intent softening, though sample is small.

suggestions.text: Pause Meta spend immediately until landing page conversion tracking fires at least 1 confirmed lead event.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has spent $159.10 with 308 clicks and zero tracked leads or GA4 conversions over 28 days — this is a confirmed tracking or landing-page capture failure, not an audience problem. Pause all active Meta ad sets until the end-to-end stack test (overdue since 2026-07-31) is completed and at least 1 lead event fires in GHL and GA4. Success check: a test submission from each landing page appears in GHL and GA4 as a conversion before any spend resumes. Target resolution: 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Complete the overdue pre-launch stack test (due 2026-07-31): one touch per channel → GHL → EHR → reporting, before any channel relaunches.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW milestones are undelivered, with 5 already 46+ days past their 2026-07-31 deadline. No channel should resume spend until the mandatory end-to-end stack test passes: a contact enters from each active channel, routes through GHL, appears in NextGen EHR, and surfaces in reporting. Nacer owns gate sign-off. Success check: documented pass for each channel leg by 2026-09-19.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions over the next 3 days; if daily average stays below 1, escalate as a local-presence gap requiring GBP triage (F1 milestone).
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 on Sep 12 and 13 after averaging ~2–3/day earlier in the month. This is a hypothesis-grade signal — 2 days is not a confirmed trend. Monitor through 2026-09-18; if the 3-day average remains below 1 action/day, treat it as a local-presence issue linked to the overdue GBP triage milestone (due 2026-07-31) and escalate to Nacer for immediate action. No paid budget change warranted yet.
